name: BuyLater
description:
Never miss the right moment to buy. BuyLater watches prices on the products you want but aren't ready to purchase, and emails you when the price drops or hits your target.

Save any product and choose an optional target price:

Price drops: buy when the price is right, not full price
Target price: set a number and hear the moment it's reached

Ask Claude to do it all mid-conversation. Say "Save these headphones and tell me when they're under $300" and it's done. Ask "What's on my BuyLater list?" anytime to review what you're waiting on.

One list for everything you're watching, across your saved stores and the Shopify network. Prices checked daily.

No passwords and no new app to manage. Sign in with just your email via a magic link. We only email you when it's time to buy, never spam.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BuyLater to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BuyLater to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://buylater.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BuyLater MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BuyLater provides these MCP tools: list_intents and save_intent.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BuyLater?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BuyLater in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
BuyLater requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BuyLater is developed by BuyLater. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
